# hyperfluid_user (Data Source)

Look up a member of the organization by email, e.g. to get the `user_id` of `hyperfluid_user_access`. Needs the `user:read` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The user must already be a member of the organization (invited and accepted).
data "hyperfluid_user" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
}

data "hyperfluid_role" "viewer" {
  name = "viewer"
}

resource "hyperfluid_user_access" "alice" {
  user_id = data.hyperfluid_user.alice.id
  roles   = [{ role_id = data.hyperfluid_role.viewer.id }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email of the member, matched case-insensitively.

### Read-Only

- `first_name` (String) First name.
- `id` (String) User id.
- `last_name` (String) Last name.
- `roles` (Attributes List) Organization-wide roles of the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Role id.
- `name` (String) Role name.
